strings.zh: 就算是刚刚抓到的{NEWLINE}弱小精灵,只要用心培育,{CLEAR}总有一天会变强的哦。{SCROLL}我想,重点是要给与精灵关爱。
strings.en: Even a weak Pokémon you’ve just caught{NEWLINE}will grow strong someday, as long as you{CLEAR}raise it with care.{SCROLL}I think the key is to give Pokémon love.

strings.zh: 要应对战斗中千变万化的情况,{NEWLINE}必须要有多种多样的道具{CLEAR}和丰富的技能机器才行。
strings.en: To handle everything that can{NEWLINE}happen in battle, you need all{CLEAR}kinds of items and plenty of TMs.

strings.zh: 是{VAR:0103:0}先生啊,{NEWLINE}我是空木博士的助手。{CLEAR}博士让我来这里{CLEAR}把一颗精灵蛋交给阿金,{CLEAR}于是我就约了他在这见面。
strings.en: Oh, it’s {VAR:0103:0}. I’m Professor{NEWLINE}Elm’s assistant. The Professor asked{CLEAR}me to bring a Pokémon Egg here for{CLEAR}Gold, so I arranged to meet him here.

strings.zh: 是{VAR:0103:0}小姐啊,{NEWLINE}我是空木博士的助手。{CLEAR}博士让我来这里{CLEAR}把一颗精灵蛋交给阿金,{CLEAR}于是我就约了他在这见面。
strings.en: Oh, it’s {VAR:0103:0}. I’m Professor{NEWLINE}Elm’s assistant. The Professor asked{CLEAR}me to bring a Pokémon Egg here for{CLEAR}Gold, so I arranged to meet him here.

strings.zh: 在那之后,空木博士接了{NEWLINE}不知是谁打来的电话。{SCROLL}我正想着之前{NEWLINE}在说些什么的时候,{CLEAR}突然,博士叫出了{SCROLL}「这事情哪,果然还是{NEWLINE}　得交给{VAR:0103:0}啊！」{SCROLL}这样的话哦！{SCROLL}总之,博士叫我{NEWLINE}把蛋交给你。{CLEAR}博士这样说了,{SCROLL}因此我就带着蛋{NEWLINE}来到这交给你。{SCROLL}好像蛋不在{NEWLINE}健康的精灵身边{CLEAR}待一段时间的话,{CLEAR}是不会孵出的哦。{SCROLL}我想这点,是{VAR:0103:0}的话,{NEWLINE}真是太适合了哟。{SCROLL}那么,就这样拜托你了哦！{SCROLL}
strings.en: After you left, Professor Elm received{NEWLINE}a phone call. I have no idea what they{CLEAR}were talking about.{SCROLL}But, after a while, Professor Elm{NEWLINE}suddenly cried out, “I can’t think of{CLEAR}anyone more suited than {VAR:0103:0}!”{SCROLL}Then he insisted that I hand this Egg to{NEWLINE}you.{SCROLL}That’s how I came here to deliver the{NEWLINE}Egg to you.{SCROLL}It seems the Egg won’t hatch unless it{NEWLINE}spends a while near healthy Pokémon.{SCROLL}That’s another reason we’ve chosen{NEWLINE}you, {VAR:0103:0}.{SCROLL}Please take care of it!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 在那之后,空木博士接了{NEWLINE}不知是谁打来的电话。{SCROLL}我正想着之前{NEWLINE}在说些什么的时候,{CLEAR}突然,博士叫出了{SCROLL}「这事情哪,果然还是{NEWLINE}　得交给{VAR:0103:0}啊！」{SCROLL}这样的话哦！{SCROLL}总之,博士叫我{NEWLINE}把蛋交给你。{CLEAR}博士这样说了,{SCROLL}因此我就带着蛋{NEWLINE}来到这交给你。{SCROLL}好像蛋不在{NEWLINE}健康的精灵身边{CLEAR}待一段时间的话,{CLEAR}是不会孵出的哦。{SCROLL}我想这点,是{VAR:0103:0}的话,{NEWLINE}真是太适合了哟。{SCROLL}那么,就这样拜托你了哦！{SCROLL}
strings.en: After you left, Professor Elm received{NEWLINE}a phone call. I have no idea what they{CLEAR}were talking about, but after a while,{CLEAR}Professor Elm suddenly cried out, “I{CLEAR}can’t think of anyone more suited for{CLEAR}that than {VAR:0103:0}!”{SCROLL}Then he insisted that I hand this Egg to{NEWLINE}you.{SCROLL}That’s how I came here to deliver the{NEWLINE}Egg to you.{SCROLL}It seems the Egg won’t hatch unless it{NEWLINE}spends a while near healthy Pokémon.{SCROLL}That’s another reason we’ve chosen{NEWLINE}you, {VAR:0103:0}.{SCROLL}Please take care of it!{SCROLL}

strings.zh: 精灵带满了呢,{NEWLINE}带不走更多精灵了。{CLEAR}那么,我会在这等你的。
strings.en: Your party is full.{NEWLINE}You cannot take the Egg yet.{CLEAR}I’ll wait here for you.

strings.zh: 诶！{NEWLINE}居然会被拒绝,{CLEAR}想都没想过啊！{SCROLL}开玩笑的吧？{NEWLINE}空木博士无论如何{CLEAR}都要拜托你的呀？
strings.en: What?{NEWLINE}I never expected you’d say no!{CLEAR}You must be kidding, right?{SCROLL}Professor Elm really wants you to{NEWLINE}take care of it...{NEWLINE}{NEWLINE}
